units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:1">Ukts. II, 1</cite> <he>והנץ שלה</he> and the flower-like substance on cucumbers.
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>הנץ שלו</he> the sproutings on the pomegranate; (Tosef. ib. I, 8 <cite ref="O00522"><he>סיאר</he></cite>, <he>שיער</he>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:8:2">Y. Shebi. IV, end, 35ᶜ</cite> (ref. to <he>משינצו</he>, ib. IV, 10) <he>לאי דו נץ שהוא וכ׳</he> what blossoming is meant? Such as promises one Robʿa of olives.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:3">Cant. R. to II, 3</cite> <he>נִיצּוֹ קודם לעליו</he> its blossoms come out before its leaves.
<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 12:1">Tosef. Par. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 11:1">XI</cite>), 1 <he>משישיר את ניצו</he> when it has shed its blossoms; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>נץ השדרה</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="L00227"><he>לוּז</he></cite> q. v.).—<he>נץ החלכ</he>, v. <cite ref="H00966"><he>חָלָב</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: נֵץ, הַנֵּץ name of a coin (Blossom) = 7/8 of an As (v. דָּרוֹסָה).
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 12a:10">Kidd. 12ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 5:12">Tosef. B. Bath. V, 12</cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>הינץ</he>, some ed. <cite ref="H01533"><he>חיצץ</he></cite>, corr. acc.).—Pl. <he>נִיצִּים</he>, <cite ref="E00466"><he>הִינְצִין</he></cite>. Y. Kidd. I, 58ᵈ; Bab. ib. l. c.; Tosef. l. c.; v. <cite ref="E00691"><he>הַנֵּץ</he></cite>.
